question: Can a protein-dynamics benchmark be assembled without letting an ensemble trained on every experimental restraint grade itself?

deterministic_roster_rule.stop_rule: stop after the first three qualifying distinct UniProt accessions; retain every screened BMRB source before the stop

files: complete one-page PED relaxation search response
every BMRB NMR-STAR file screened before the deterministic stop
PED entry metadata and ensemble coordinate archive for each selected protein
frozen_source_retention.compression: gzip with mtime=0 for deterministic bytes

readiness_decision.ready_if: three distinct proteins satisfy every metadata, observable, coordinate, license, and provenance requirement

leakage_contract.forbidden_use: A deposited ensemble that was generated or selected using an observable may not predict that observable as held-out evidence.
leakage_contract.future_training_rule: Every candidate ensemble must be regenerated using training observables only; acceptance observables remain unopened until prediction files are frozen.
leakage_contract.future_protein_holdout: Leave-one-protein-out evaluation must fit all model choices without any observable from the held-out UniProt accession.
leakage_contract.future_denominator_rule: Single-structure and short conventional-MD denominators must use the same public inputs, observable forward models, and sampling budget ledger.

pilot_disclosure.boundary: These inspections established file formats and revealed that PED ontology labels do not guarantee deposited numeric relaxation loops. No prediction error, candidate ensemble, or acceptance outcome was inspected.

controls.positive: a synthetic NMR-STAR payload containing T1 and T2 loops with 20 numeric rows each must qualify
controls.negative: an ontology-like label without numeric dynamic-observable loops must not qualify

next_gate_if_ready: Freeze residue mapping, observable forward models, a single-structure denominator, a budget-matched short-MD denominator, and training-only observable/protein splits before executing any candidate.
interpretation_boundaries: This packet audits public data access, machine readability, provenance, licensing, and leakage risk only.
It does not evaluate an AlphaFold model, molecular-dynamics force field, ensemble generator, or biological function prediction.
It does not establish that a deposited ensemble predicts data it did not use.
No protein-engineering, clinical, therapeutic, wet-lab, or solved-frontier claim is permitted.
